nodes.label: Retro-Futuristic Space-Age Art Style

nodes.rationale: States chain tests use a mocked LLM for fast deterministic runs, which conflicts with CLAUDE.md's note that run_chain_tests.py requires LLM access

nodes.label: Multi-step Chain-of-Thought Planning
nodes.rationale: Planning layer sits between the goal system and the action decision chain; each cycle the current step is fed to the action decision as a strong suggestion that urgent needs can override; enables reasoning like 'to eat I need the store, but first money, so first work'

nodes.label: Plan Step Completion Detection & Replan Trigger
nodes.norm_label: plan step completion detection & replan trigger
nodes.rationale: Step completes when chosen action matches action_hint and satisfaction improved; replan if actual_cycles > 2x estimate (STUCK_MULTIPLIER) or overridden 3+ cycles; MAX_REPLANS=3 then abandon (goal confidence -0.2); plan completion advances goal progress +0.3; mid/long goals wait until source needs < 50%

nodes.label: Focus Tied to Sleep Need
nodes.rationale: focus = clamp(sleep_satisfaction*0.8+20, 30, 100); buffer capacity = floor(3 + 4*focus/100); context-switch penalty -5 when the top item changes source between cycles

nodes.label: Salience-Based Working Memory Buffer (3-7 items)
nodes.rationale: Items enter by computed salience without LLM calls: needs (100-sat)/100 x level weight (physio 1.0 .. self-act 0.2), top-2 emotions intensity/100, active plan step 0.7, goals (1-progress) x confidence x 0.5, recent experience 0.6 decaying over 3 cycles, environment 0.5

nodes.rationale: Plans in docs/plans/ carry a directive to use superpowers:executing-plans; executed one task at a time with tests run after each change and an atomic conventional commit per task

nodes.label: Goal Horizons (short / mid / long-term)
nodes.rationale: Horizon-specific confidence decay (0.03 / 0.008 / 0.002 per hour) and abandonment thresholds (0.1 / 0.05 / 0.05) so short-term goals die fast if not pursued; MAX_GOALS=10 split ~3/4/3

nodes.label: Action-to-Sprite Mapping for Tamagotchi UI
nodes.rationale: The UI picks a persona sprite by keyword-matching the chosen action text; jenbina_drink.png is selected when the action mentions drink, water, thirst, hydrat, beverage, tea or coffee, so the user gets immediate visual feedback that Jenbina is satisfying a physiological (water/thirst) need.

nodes.label: Action-Keyword to Sprite Mapping
nodes.rationale: The Tamagotchi UI gives visual feedback on what Jenbina is doing by matching keywords in the chosen action text (walk, move, explor, travel, wander, go to, visit, roam, stroll) to jenbina_walks.png; action sprites take priority over emotion sprites so the user sees behaviour, not just mood. Simple substring matching is used instead of an LLM call to keep sprite selection instant and deterministic.

nodes.label: Test Suite Workflow (push/manual)

nodes.label: Playwright E2E Tests Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual-only trigger because E2E needs a live LLM (OPENAI_API_KEY secret); Google SSO bypassed via JENBINA_SKIP_AUTH=1; coverage collected but not gated (--cov-fail-under=0); Playwright traces uploaded on failure

nodes.label: Feedback Loop E2E Test Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual dispatch with iterations_per_test input to bound LLM call volume; 30-minute job timeout and 1200s pytest timeout because each iteration makes real LLM calls

nodes.label: JENBINA_SKIP_AUTH E2E Auth Bypass Flag
nodes.rationale: Env var set to '1' in E2E workflows so Playwright can reach the app without Google SSO

nodes.label: Jenbina Fear / Scared Emotional State
nodes.rationale: The UI shows this portrait only when the dominant emotion reported by person.emotion_system.get_dominant_emotions(1) is 'fear' with intensity above 30 (core/ui/simulation.py get_jenbina_image_for_emotion); weaker fear falls back to jenbina_base.png so the sprite does not flip on faint emotional noise. The gasping wide-eyed expression visually communicates the fear state to the user without text.

nodes.label: Retro Pulp Sci-Fi Illustration Style
nodes.rationale: Persona art is rendered as 1950s/60s space-age pulp cover illustration (bubble helmet, silver suit, flying saucer, painted starfield). nodes.label: UFO Tractor Beam Threat Motif
